numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.2 Fixed data and exact height domain.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: All fixed alpha/beta/A and log endpoints preserved verbatim, finite real T>=0 and z in (0,1], positive arguments, separate scaled endpoint and no lattice-attainability inference.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.3 Strict rational logarithm brackets with a derived remainder.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: All 32-term finite geometric identity, strictly positive remainder integral and strict upper bound, rational bracket inequalities and exact table preserved; classical DLMF attribution retained. No fixed certificate rerun.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.4 Derivative comparison and its lower quadratic.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Every derivative cancellation, positive denominator, N-Q strict inequality, q0/q1/q2 formula and differentiable endpoint extension retained exactly.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.5 Complete fixed quadratic certificate.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Every rational coefficient, Q(1), delta and positive residual in both tables retained. q1,q2<0 and endpoint minimum imply universal strict derivative bounds; execution context alone archived.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.6 Strict order at every finite height and at the scaled endpoint.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Integration and derivative-at-zero arguments retain strict 2>3>5>7 at every finite height and all three scaled gaps at both endpoints; no equality and no sharpness assertion.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.7 The exact fractional resource problem.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: All real capacities retained: negative infeasible with optional -infinity, nonnegative compact existence, exact H0..H4 and C(T); no lower budget/two-corner/cutoff imposed. Inherited framework and mass/domain distinctions reattached as citations.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.9 The complete optimum value.**

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.10 A constructive nonnegative primal/dual gap.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Exact nonnegative primal/dual gap and all zero-product cases, nonnegative resource and box multipliers, stationarity, negative-capacity dual infimum -infinity unattained. Boyd/Vandenberghe citation attached.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.11 All matching nonnegative prices.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Complete resource-price sets: zero, all four open intervals, three internal closed prefixes, saturation [0,s7], slack {0}; attained zero gap, upper multipliers and negative infeasibility retained.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.12 Completeness of prices and uniqueness of vectors.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Necessity and sufficiency of every price endpoint, objective equality iff unique vector for every r>=0, constructive proofs at fractional/prefix/zero/saturation/slack and complete box multipliers retained.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.13 Mass-four mixture and permutation labels.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Mass-four positive measure and log integral, point-mass notation, mean versus individual feasibility, upper interpolation corner beyond capacity, all permutations feasible and equality iff same vector, all 24 labels at boundaries retained.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.14 Density limits and all equality qualifications.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: Unscaled s=zA/h+o(z), unattained zero gap infima, absence of finite-height ties including T=0, formal zero equalities and strictly separated scaled extension retained.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.15 Value limits, endpoint degeneracy and scaled optimization.**
numbered_correspondence.analytical_correspondence: D<0 for fixed r with exact scaled limit; all feasible vectors optimize at unscaled z=0, singleton iff r=0, all endpoint dual prices; unique scaled optimizer, full price table and additive constant retained.

numbered_correspondence.original_heading: **33.16 Logarithm series and moment objectives.**
